title: Simon 5.5 for compactly supported g: the monotonicity inequality at all radii
statement: Assume the weighted monotonicity identity (W), i.e. the exact frozen statement of weighted_monotonicity_identity. Let n ≥ 1, ℓ ∈ ℕ, V a rectifiable n-varifold in E = ℝ^{n+ℓ} with μ = μ_V finite on compacts, dim T_xV = n μ-a.e. and x ↦ p_{T_xV} μ-a.e. strongly measurable; U ⊆ E open; V has generalized mean curvature H in U; g ∈ C¹(U), g ≥ 0, with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ U; ζ ∈ E and 0 < s ≤ r. Then s^{−n}∫_{B_s(ζ)} g dμ ≤ r^{−n}∫_{B_r(ζ)} g dμ + ∫_{(s,r]} τ^{−n}(∫_{B_τ(ζ)} (|∇^M g| + g|H|) dμ) dτ.
